name: Bosch
sub: The largest Tier-1, from braking redundancy to ADAS sensors
leadership: Christian Fischer, Chairman of the board of management since 1 July 2026; Christoph Hartung, President of Cross-Domain Computing Solutions
about: Largest global automotive supplier with braking, steering, sensors, ADAS, and vehicle integration capabilities; former CARIAD automated-driving partner.
model: Sells components, systems and integration services to OEMs and commercial vehicle platforms.
opMaturity: Commercial-scaled in components; AV alliance ended
deployment: Global OEM programs; autonomous trucking work with Kodiak and prior CARIAD partnership
metrics: Reuters reported VW/CARIAD and Bosch ended their AD tie-up in 2026; Bosch still invests heavily in AI and ADAS
signal: Bosch remains a foundational integrator even after the VW alliance ended because redundant actuation and sensors are essential to AV platforms.

sources.title: Bosch CEO Resigns and Board Announces Leadership Changes
